verdict.rationale: LangSmith's documentation describes online evaluations that run automatically on production traces. They cover safety checks, format validation, quality heuristics and reference-free LLM-as-judge, with filters and sampling rates to control cost. This is framed explicitly as evaluating live traffic in real time, alongside offline dataset experiments. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that online evaluators run reliably at production scale.
